properties.description:
KNK Outbound is a done-for-you client acquisition agency for boutique B2B service firms. We book qualified discovery calls straight onto your calendar, so you stop relying on referrals and never have to run outreach yourself.

What we actually do:
We pinpoint your ideal clients, reach out to their decision-makers on your behalf, and book qualified discovery calls directly onto your calendar. The entire system runs in the background. Your team never touches it, you never manage it, and you never write a single email.

You show up to the call. You close the client. That's the split.

Who we work with:
Boutique consulting firms, B2B agencies, retained search firms, and professional service businesses with 10 to 50 employees that lean too heavily on referrals and want a predictable client acquisition channel.

Why now:
In 2026, the firms that win the next five years are building structured outbound, not waiting for the phone to ring. We make that transition painless and your pipeline predictable.

Curious if we're a fit? Book a free 60-minute pipeline review at knkoutbound.com.

It runs outbound end to end: researched target lists, cold email and LinkedIn, handling every reply, calling interested prospects personally and booking the meetings. Content and ads run alongside only where they help. Clients only get qualified conversations in their calendar. Pricing is public, from EUR 3,300 a month with everything included.
